messages:
marta: @channel Moonlit run tonight from Panther Park? 6:30pm, easy 3-mile loop + quick cooldown/stretch. Thinking we can grab shakes after at the cafe by the river. :crescent_moon: :running_man:

alex: I'm in if it's not pouring. last-minute route change ok?

tara: did stairs this morning so leaning rest tonight, but vote: almond or whey for post-run shakes? i'm team almond. :seedling:

kyle: WHEY. chocolate. always chocolate. :muscle: (also bringing a spare headlamp)

jen: pea-protein vegan here, pls no dairy near me 😅

sam: i'll be ~10-15m late from the office, save me a spot. Strava loop: https://strava.app.link/abc123

marta: @kyle legend, thanks. @jen we'll get a vegan option too. @sam saved. heads-up — river path is darker after the underpass, might want lights.

jen: can someone bring a couple of extra masks? allergic to the cafe's peanut smoothie machine lol

marta: i can bring 2 headlamps and spare masks. meeting point: north park entrance near the blue bench at 6:25 for warmup.

ops-bot: Reminder: Running Club meetup tonight at 6:30pm — safety first. If you need to cancel, drop a note here. :bell:

alex: quick informal poll — post-run shake choice? Reply with emoji: :one: whey (kyle) :two: almond (tara) :three: vegan (jen)

kyle: :one: :thumbsup:

tara: :two:

jen: :three: :heart:

sam: :one: I'm bringing cash for everyone who wants to chip in for toppings.

marta: Perfect. See y'all later! Also if anyone wants to do 2x laps bring an extra layer. (reaction :raised_hands: 5)
